messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — client sent a DPA + vendor-security form during onboarding. They want DPA answers, a one-page dataflow, and a short KMS/key provenance note. Deadline = EOD Thursday.
support-bot: uploaded attachment client_dpa_vendor_form.pdf (shared)
olivia_pm: renewal review in 9 days. CS needs this quick.
maria_cs: priority: confirm rotation cadence, audit logging, BYOK availability, and nonprod access controls.
sanjay_security: I can draft a concise attestation. Recommendation: keep Hosted vs Dedicated wording high-level unless they ask for specifics.
liam_eng: proposed snippet for answers:
```
Hosted: Keys managed by Redwood with HSM-backed storage and per-tenant separation.
Dedicated/Private: Customers may provide BYOK; we support integration and validation.
```
maria_cs: add rotation + logs line — they asked for evidence of rotation and where logs live.
sanjay_security: draft line: "Keys are rotated annually or upon incident; rotation and access events are logged and retained per our audit retention policy." ok?
olivia_pm: ok. Also: can someone prepare a redacted key provenance sample (no real IDs) and a one-pager dataflow PNG.
liam_eng: redacted sample ready (replace IDs with Xs):
```
Alias: redwood-client-2024
KMS Key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
Created: 2023-05-10
LastRotated: 2024-05-10
RotationPolicy: annual
```
maria_cs: perfect. Attestation drafted by Sanjay + provenance + dataflow will be attached. I'll post answers and ask the customer to confirm sufficiency.
support-bot: uploaded: client_attestation.txt, client_key_provenance_redacted.txt, client_dataflow_onepager.png
olivia_pm: please capture their feedback in the onboarding checklist after they reply.
maria_cs: will do. If they escalate BYOK/network peering, we'll loop infra and sales for timeline/impact. Thanks :raised_hands:
